raw_response:
I farm 8 mu, so I do not play with too many changes. What worked last year, I will mostly keep. Around here in Quzhou, if wheat and maize both do well, the whole year is steady; if one crop fails, the money gets tight fast. I have well water, so I will lean on that. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, because I have seen those do better in nearby fields and they are worth the extra money. On fertilizer, I will not cut too hard. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than watch the field go pale and lose yield. For wheat, I will put the main fertilizer in before sowing, then add nitrogen again at jointing. For maize, I will put base fertilizer down and then topdress once when it is growing fast. Because my family has only 2 people and some work off-farm, I will keep tillage simple with rotary tillage, not heavy ploughing every time. For pests, I will spray when needed but I will not leave it too late, usually about 2 times on each crop in a normal year. With water from the well, I will plan about 3 irrigations for wheat and 2 for maize, then adjust if rain is good.
